description: This file defines classes for configuring the X Window System in different Red Hat/Fedora versions, including parsing command-line options and generating configuration strings.

classes.name: FC3_XConfig
classes.description: Class for configuring X Window System settings for Fedora Core 3, with methods for parsing options and generating configuration strings.

classes.name: FC6_XConfig
classes.description: Subclass of FC3_XConfig for Fedora Core 6, with additional or modified options.

classes.name: F9_XConfig
classes.description: Subclass of FC6_XConfig for Fedora 9, removing certain options.

classes.name: F10_XConfig
classes.description: Subclass of F9_XConfig for Fedora 10, further deprecating options.

classes.name: F14_XConfig
classes.description: Subclass of F10_XConfig for Fedora 14, removing more options based on version.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each class, initializing configuration parameters.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Generates the string representation of the configuration command.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets class attributes accordingly.

methods.name: deleteRemovedAttrs
methods.description: Removes attributes that are deprecated or removed in subclasses.
